name: uhppote-desk
description: Web application to manage UHPPOTE UT0311-L0x access controllers (1/2/4-door Wiegand boards), replacing the Windows "Access Control" software (N3000). Controller discovery and configuration, people, cards and permissions with automatic sync, time profiles and scheduled tasks, live monitor with photos, event history, attendance reports, anomaly detection. Home Assistant integration over MQTT (auto discovery), webhooks, Telegram/email/ntfy/Gotify notifications, automation rules and a mobile app (PWA) with fingerprint/Face ID. Interface in English, Italian, Spanish, French and German. Requires "host" networking to discover the controllers and receive their UDP events.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that will own the data folder (Unraid: 99 = nobody)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that will own the data folder (Unraid: 100 = users)

variables.name: Web port
variables.description: Port of the web interface (host networking: change it if already used by another container). If you change it, the WebUI button still opens port 8080: open http://[server IP]:[new port]/ instead

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Password of the admin user, applied at every start. If empty, a password is generated on the first start (see the log) and must be changed at first login

variables.name: Local IP facing the controllers
variables.description: Server IP on the controllers' network (0.0.0.0 = all interfaces)

variables.name: Discovery broadcast
variables.description: Broadcast address used to discover controllers; the broadcast of the controllers' subnet is recommended, e.g. 192.168.1.255:60000

variables.name: Event listen address
variables.description: UDP address:port on which events are received

variables.name: Event destination
variables.description: IP:port of this server as reached by the controllers, e.g. 192.168.1.10:60001 (without it events arrive only through periodic polling)

variables.name: HTTPS-only cookies
variables.description: true if published behind an HTTPS reverse proxy

variables.name: Packet debug
variables.description: Log every packet in hexadecimal

variables.name: Public address
variables.description: Public HTTPS address behind a reverse proxy, e.g. https://doors.example.com (mobile app: fingerprint/Face ID, push). See docs/MOBILE.md

variables.name: MQTT broker
variables.description: Home Assistant integration: MQTT broker URL, e.g. mqtt://192.168.1.10:1883 (empty = disabled). See docs/HOME-ASSISTANT.md

variables.name: MQTT username
variables.description: MQTT broker user

variables.name: MQTT password
variables.description: MQTT broker password

variables.name: MQTT door control
variables.description: false = Home Assistant can see the doors but not open them

variables.name: MQTT language
variables.description: Language of the Home Assistant entity names and event texts: en, it, es, fr, de

variables.name: MQTT base topic
variables.description: Prefix of the published topics

variables.name: MQTT discovery prefix
variables.description: Home Assistant discovery prefix

variables.name: Time zone
variables.description: Used for the time set on the controllers and for reports

variables.name: Controller reply timeout
variables.description: Maximum wait for a controller reply, in milliseconds

variables.name: Retries
variables.description: Additional attempts after a timeout (only for operations that can be repeated safely; door opening is never repeated)

variables.name: Status check interval
variables.description: Seconds between controller status checks (online/offline, doors)

variables.name: Event download interval
variables.description: Seconds between event downloads from the controllers, a safety net for events not received over UDP

variables.name: Clock correction threshold
variables.description: Difference in seconds beyond which the controller clock is corrected automatically (0 = never)

variables.name: Initial event import
variables.description: Number of events already stored on a controller to import the first time it is connected

variables.name: Session duration
variables.description: Operator session duration, in hours

variables.name: Backup hour
variables.description: Hour of the daily database backup into /data/backups (-1 = disabled)

variables.name: Backups kept
variables.description: Number of daily backups to keep

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: debug, info, warn or error
